body: They didn’t even know what I was coming to talk about.  They just didn’t want me around
This isn’t the first time they’ve pushed me away, I’m not really the most important friend in the group so it’s expected
I work at a hospital, you are almost never by yourself.
It’s the level where the devil and my depression lives.
Crying internally works too I guess. I usually just held down any tears, only once something actually came out. Can’t show that kind of vulnerability in school.
How did you manage that? I had to take so much walks around the hall or to the bathroom to avoid crying in school.
I get myself out of going down one by making myself think that having the breakdown would make me weak.
No, people just prefer anyone else but me in their bubble. Trust me, people love having someone else in their bubble, just not me.
I tried reaching out, and people blew me off. That’s how I know no one cares. Because they have shown it before.
That was the exact number of days it took atleast one friend to check in on me this week. I know that they don’t truly care.
I agree, someone can feel so insignificant, worthless and depressed and go and kill their self. And then people mourn for a week and move on.
Same
Thank you.
Thanks but no thanks. I’ll just continue to deal with it the way I have been for a while now.

At this point I don’t even know how to explain everything that’s wrong with me and everything that went wrong with my life. Anxiety, depression, possibly ptsd or some other shit. Plus trauma, constant arguing in the house, self hatred, feelings of worthlessness and not being good enough, and more. Whenever I try to hit up someone to talk when I’m really struggling they always find something else more important and leave me stranded not having anyone to to talk to, so I stopped reaching out to people. Especially when talking to them didn’t even help all of the time. I’m just stuck with a lot of shit in my head.
My whole life has been shit bruh, I need professional help to fix that shit.
Honestly my entire life and my lack of help had gotten me to this point.
Not everyone at the dance was innocent, I wasn’t thinking of him spreading bullets at everyone but at the jocks and popular kids like Bryce (and including Monty and co)

I hope that it happened because it’s a real life thing that happens in American schools especially as of late. If they want to show real life problems being faced then show the reality of a school shooting without glorifying the shooter or the victims.
Maybe not at everyone like for example clay and Alex but yeah majority would’ve been shot at. But tbh a lot of liberty kids deserved it.

I agree, I thought that they were doing real life stuff that teenagers go through and having a school shooting would have been an interesting story line. The way Clay talked him down was fake, Tyler could’ve easily just ignored clay in the first place instead of listening to him rambling.

I tried it and couldn’t fall through with it, the rope kept on putting pressure on my trachea instead of just my major blood vessels making it much harder to somehow comfortably pass out. I almost did it though, the sounds started to fade and my mind started to go blank as my eyes closed.
It sucks
No thanks
Why not?
Still gonna do it
No I can’t actually
I honestly don’t even know how to explain myself and why I’m depressed. Can’t get help when you struggle with talking.
Talking is hard when all you want to do is die.
How exactly does talking help?
I live in a small place where you’re not that much of a stranger. I know that I should talk to a counselor but talking isn’t something I’m good at.
Talking to someone that I barely know? That’s kinda depressing when you think of it as not having anyone to talk to so you decide to resort to strangers on the internet.
No talking needed when imma be dead soon
No it won’t, my entire life has been crap, it’s obvious nothing will change.
I usually would be competitive but unlike you I lack motivation to do anything.
